mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window during declining FEDFUNDS periods.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5% for 3 consecutive months signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains < 0.03 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in PAYEMS and decreases in UNRATE signal labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce positive returns when their correlation drops below 0.7 or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1100 thousand units during late-cycle expansion signals robust housing demand, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1100 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 relative to the prior quarter indicates accelerating economic growth, which elevates corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution shows no significant positive mean (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 5.0% for 3 consecutive months indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in CPIAUCSL and RSAFS signal inflationary pressure that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days in high-inflation regimes.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL and RSAFS fails to produce negative returns when their correlation drops below 0.8 or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 100.5 index points during manufacturing recovery indicates expanding industrial output, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5 during manufacturing recovery, or Rank IC < 0.03.
